name: Wreath
definition: ring of foliage, flowers or other decoration made to hang on a door or wall as a seasonal or festive ornament (an Advent wreath made for worship is F4).
reason: Ring form, hung; garland is a strand. Sold as its own type; occasion is a tag; Advent wreath stays F4 by step 14.

name: Apothecary jar
definition: straight-sided glass jar with a lid, often footed, made to stand on display (a jar made to store food is B5).
reason: Value of the retail Type facet that sets the B4.1.1 kinds (memo 4b); form differs from ginger jar and vase.

name: Feather banner
definition: tall narrow flag carried on a curved pole with a ground spike or base, made to stand outside as a sign or decoration.
reason: Own Type value in the flag facet; use form differs (stands on its own pole); B4.8.1 axis is use form.

name: Wind spinner
definition: garden ornament of vanes, cups or spirals that turns in the wind, staked or hung.
reason: Sold under its own name beside wind chimes; makes no sound, so not a chime; memo section 4 foresees spinners.

name: Garden pedestal or column
definition: ornamental pedestal, plinth or column made to stand in a garden, alone or carrying an urn, statue or gazing ball.
reason: Sold as its own garden-ornament type; serves several B4 kinds, so not a B4.10 part (CV-17).

name: Scented sachet
definition: small bag or pouch of scented material made to scent a drawer, wardrobe or room (an odour absorber is B6).
reason: Distinct product form of the scent carrier (B4.4.1 axis); scents, does not remove odour (B4-O3); memo section 4 names sachets.
Candle dish is holder_form 'candle plate' of the candle holder (memo 14, K-180).

name: Floating candle
definition: small, wide, flat candle made to float and burn on water in a bowl or vase.
reason: Candle form is the B4.3.1 kind axis; floating form is sold and named as its own type; not a tealight (no cup).

name: Bakhoor burner [mabkhara]
reason: Regional name of a home-fragrance incense burner (C11, rule R): non-maker named form, region Gulf; rite burners stay F4.
Pyrotechnic giving a display of colour (coloured smoke); firework definition covers it; legal class in C17 (B-19).

name: Tree skirt
definition: cloth or mat laid round the foot of a Christmas tree to decorate it and hide the stand.
reason: Sold under its own name; decorates the standing tree display; serves real and artificial trees, so not a B4.10 part.

name: Christmas stocking
definition: large decorative sock made to hang at a fireplace or wall at Christmas and be filled with gifts.
reason: Hung decoration sold as its own type; not a tree ornament or garland by form.

name: Advent calendar (reusable)
definition: reusable display calendar of fabric, wood or card with numbered doors or pockets for the days before Christmas (one sold filled with confectionery is food; an Advent wreath is F4).
reason: Generic seasonal display sold by name; not made for worship (step 14 names the wreath, not the calendar).

name: Ornament hook
definition: wire or clip hook made to hang a tree ornament.
reason: Part made for one B4 object, the tree ornament (CV-17, S3); closing parts sub-family.
S3: a stand made to hold one object follows it; it holds a cut real tree (C3, K-72); artificial trees ship with their own base.
Key step 30, furniture and storage branch, lists hooks (B1); picture hooks are not made for one B4 object.

name: Mirror ball [disco ball]
definition: sphere covered in small mirrors, often turned by a motor, that scatters light as a party or display effect.
reason: Effect device, not a light source (not B4.9 or B3); B4.5.4 axis is the effect device.

name: Wall vase
definition: flat-backed vase with a hanging fitting, made to hang on a wall.
reason: Own Type value; made only for the wall mount with a different body (rule M(a)), as the mirror placement kinds.

candidate: Table vase / floor vase (Wayfair Type values)
reason: Same open-vessel body at different size and placement: size attribute of the vase (C6, memo 4b).

name: House flag [decorative flag]
definition: decorative or seasonal flag made to fly from a pole bracket on a house (a polity's flag is B4.8.1.01 or B4.8.1.02).
reason: Own Type value beside garden flag; use form (house bracket pole against garden stake) is the B4.8.1 axis.
A printed banner hung from cords or grommets as a sign is the hanging sign; a festive string of flags is bunting B4.5.1.04.

name: Confetti
definition: small pieces of paper, foil or other material thrown or scattered as a party decoration.
reason: Shop category 'Confetti & Party Poppers' names it; used up at a party (B4.5.3 axis); a confetti cannon stays party popper.

name: Candlestick
definition: holder with a socket or spike made to hold one or more taper or pillar candles upright on a stem or base.
reason: Memo 14 instruction: a fetched shop sells candlesticks as their own category; raised from holder_form to kind (K-180).

name: Tealight holder
definition: small open holder made to hold a tealight.
reason: Memo 14 instruction: a fetched shop sells tealight holders as their own category; raised from holder_form to kind.
A demon-breaking arrow is a shrine talisman made for a rite (step 14, B4-O2, like shimenawa).
Flat sign or plaque; stake or wall fixing is an installation attribute (rule M, C12).

name: Loose incense [bakhoor]
definition: scented wood chips, resin or powder burned on charcoal or a heater to scent a room (rite incense is F4).
reason: Form not covered by stick, cone or coil; bakhoor burners imply it; regional word in brackets (rule R). No logged page: attest in HV_NK.
A strand of tassels is a garland; the tassel is a material or style attribute.
